description: This file contains the main application component for the Local Note Keeper application, handling the storage, listing, CRUD operations, and selection logic for notes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: The main application shell for Local Note Keeper. It manages the state of notes, selected note, and UI interactions.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID and updates the state with the new note.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note by ID and updates the selected note if it was deleted.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Updates the content of an existing note or adds a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: A no-op function that is called for saving the note content.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Sets the selected note by ID.
